items.title: Antidote Kit
items.summary: Your coding agent forgets your rules. The Antidote Kit keeps them in plain files in your repo, read every session. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and Copilot.
items.label: Flagship · pay once

items.title: Antidote Kit Starter
items.summary: The free starting point: a day-one path and two skills, so your agent stops forgetting your rules.
items.label: Free · open source

items.title: Narrative Token SSOT
items.summary: Character names as build-time tokens, so AI agents can't drift them. One registry file for every name in your scenes and prompts.
items.label: Free · MIT

items.title: AuDHD Screener
items.summary: A free self-report screener built on open-access measures. It runs in your browser and is a starting point, not a diagnosis.
items.label: Free screener

items.title: Coach Hype
items.summary: 1:1 coaching, body doubling and the Flourish Engine, built on Dr. Neil Fiore's The Now Habit. Free readout, no tracking.
items.label: Coaching

items.title: Rel8r
items.summary: A pocket attachment coach that helps you rel8 to what's really happening. Includes Dating Red Flags, an illustrated graphic novel.
items.label: Attachment coach
